audit.recompute_scope: the eligibility counts and seed ids come from the eligibility pass, not from the raw rows; the oracle arm's per-row bits are recomputed from the retained per-row operating-fraction max-degree residuals; the heuristic arm's per-row bits are recomputed from the retained per-row full dual-degree residual profiles (both degree residuals at all 8 grid points, 16 floats per candidate) — BOTH non-learned arms recompute from the raw rows alone; the learned arm's per-row bits are recomputable only with the retained model (hash-pinned in training.model_state_sha256); this block recomputes the aggregation from the retained raw rows

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction max-degree column) at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.7) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction max-degree column) at the held-out fraction 0.6
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.6) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the polluted argmin observed-residual oracle (operating-fraction max-degree column) at the held-out fraction 0.8
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_oracle(seed, 0.8) with d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.description: the learned router beats the non-learned grid-mean log1p max-degree profile heuristic at the held-out fraction 0.7
claims.estimand: mean over eligible seeds of d_heur(seed, 0.7) with d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc, accuracies over R=4 shared replicate draws

claims.method: one-sided Student-t lower bounds with Bonferroni correction; the generator seed is the inference unit

baselines.heuristic: descriptive non-learned heuristic: argmin of the grid-mean log1p max-degree profile (the profile-shape comparator of H4)
baselines.oracle: polluted argmin observed-residual oracle: argmin of the operating-fraction max-degree residual column (max of the two degree residuals; polluted at every fraction — no clean column exists)

design.declared_caveat: the comparison is asymmetric by design: the learned router integrates the full max-degree degraded profile; the oracle reads only one polluted column (the operating fraction's max-degree residual). The heuristic baseline in H4 is the profile-shape non-learned comparator. Demo-scale numbers are not evidence.
design.eligibility_rule: the instance builds and the clean audit on the UNDEGRADED instance passes at BOTH degrees (true misfit <= 1e-9 at both degrees, every decoy > 1e-9 at some degree); deterministic per seed and never entering features
design.estimand: per (seed, fraction) accuracies over R=4 shared replicates; paired differences d_oracle = learned_acc - oracle_acc and d_heur = learned_acc - heuristic_acc
design.feature: the 18-dim max-degree no-anchor degradation-profile feature vector exactly as this runner's two_complex_candidate_features computes it: log1p of the max of the degree-1 and degree-2 observed commutation residuals at the 8 grid points under the row's observation draw (8 columns), the 7 first-difference slopes, and 3 masked structural dims (V', kept edge count, F') read off the masked observation
design.observation_degradation: universa.partial2.TwoComplexObservationModel with mask_fraction = 0.25 (edge columns of B1 and the matching rows of B2 removed, consistently) AND dual sign corruption (corrupt_b1_fraction = corrupt_b2_fraction = g) at every grid point; the profile grid 0.2..0.9 by 0.1 excludes 0.0 — no clean column exists anywhere (the no-anchor regime, lifted to two degrees)
design.permutation: per (seed, fraction) from subseed(seed, 'router-v2-permutation', f'{fraction:.6f}'), shared across the row's replicates, with audited labels
design.raw_row_retention: each eval raw row retains, per candidate, the full dual-degree residual profile (both observed commutation residuals at all 8 grid points; 16 raw floats, permuted candidate order) plus the operating-fraction max-degree residual, so the oracle AND heuristic arms' per-row bits are recomputable from the raw rows alone (the audit block recomputes them); only the learned arm needs the retained hash-pinned model
design.replicate_subseed: subseed(seed, 'sealed-replicate', str(fraction), str(replicate_index)) per data row, driving the mask draw AND both nested corruption draws (partial2-mask, partial2-b1, partial2-b2); the same observation_seed feeds all arms within a row (paired)
design.task_family: 2-complex switch instances via universa.complexes2.make_two_complex_switch_instance(num_vertices=8, num_edges=14, num_classes=6, num_decoys=3); K=4 candidates, true target at index 0 pre-permutation
design.train_replicates: one replicate (index 0) per train (seed, fraction); 800 rows

training.standardization: input mean/std measured on the train block only
training.validation_monitor: the train block itself; the frozen design defines no validation split
